selectionPolicy.developmentRole: tuning-only; suppression decoder was selected here
selectionPolicy.humanReviewedDevelopmentRole: provisional boundary diagnostics; documents remain in-progress and source groups overlap model development
selectionPolicy.heldFeedbackRole: file-level held-out inclusion/veto evaluation; model-origin boundaries were not user-adjusted and are not boundary gold
selectionPolicy.combinedRole: diagnostic only; not a model-selection score

serve.target: valid samples within ±1.0s of human serve contact

deadState.target: valid local end-transition samples: post-end positive; pre-end and pre-serve controls negative

oracleAnchoredCoverage.note: Each human end supplies the local anchor required by this refinement head; this measures end evidence coverage, not standalone global precision.

suppression-overlap-exclusion-retrained.target: within the selected target universe: production-selected or explicit valid non-rally samples positive; human rally samples negative

operational.metric: production-decoded suppression samples in selected target universe

combinedServeParallelPaths.note: Production does not create one merged serve detector. Each serve head is decoded inside its own three-head model path, then the resulting rally intervals are unioned. These diagnostics preserve both path alerts, count duplicate alerts in precision, and count each reference serve once in recall.
